registered_before: any full-fidelity (dt 37.5 s) run of the DOE finalists
finalists: top 8 geometry-valid designs per (regime, PCM) pair by CHEAP robust mean paired gain (mean over anchors of g_window)
if_fail: the cheap screen is NOT used for selection: every candidate that enters the search/funnel is re-evaluated at full fidelity
note: gains are near zero at 100 L/day, so rank agreement can fail from noise alone; that outcome is reported, not tuned away.
